## Prospective Graduate Students
Graduate students in EmoLab are expected to take increasing ownership of research questions, experimental design, data analysis, and scientific writing. Prior programming experience is helpful but not required; willingness to learn quantitative methods is essential.

If you are considering graduate study, send a short introduction, your research interests, and a CV or transcript to **jongwankim80@jbnu.ac.kr**.
:::

::: {.join-card}
## Undergraduate Researchers
Undergraduate researchers typically begin with behavioral experiments, reading and discussion, basic statistics, and MATLAB or related analysis tools before moving toward an independent project.

Students at Jeonbuk National University who are interested in joining the lab are welcome to inquire by email.
:::
:::
